headline: Owens Takes 100-Metre Gold, Electrifies Berlin Stadium
dispatch: Jesse Owens of the United States crossed the finish line first in the 100-metre sprint at the Berlin Olympic Games yesterday, claiming his first gold medal of the competition. The Ohio State sprinter finished in 10.3 seconds before a packed crowd that included senior German officials. Owens is expected to compete in the long jump and 200-metre events in the coming days.
answer: Jesse Owens wins 100m gold at Berlin Olympics, 1936
